findings.description: Accordion metadata renders at 13px, below the approved 16px minimum for receipt instructions.
findings.failure_scenario: A runner reads interval count and effort labels on a compact ticket and receives smaller text than the approved receipt readability floor.

findings.description: New ticket assertions depend on presentation class names and DOM sibling order instead of accessible behavior.
findings.failure_scenario: A harmless CSS refactor or wrapper change breaks the journey although the accessible accordion and safety guidance still work.

findings.description: Result-action coverage selects and asserts presentation classes.
findings.failure_scenario: Renaming the action container or primary-button class breaks tests without changing action availability, ordering, or download behavior.

findings.description: The prior completed plan is lost if the page reloads after Pull another and before the next pull.
findings.failure_scenario: Reloading on configuration removes the comparison plan, so a later pull could reproduce the completed workout.

findings.description: The download object URL is revoked immediately after the synthetic click.
findings.failure_scenario: A browser could defer navigation until after revocation and produce an empty download.

findings.description: The result action tests assert button order.
findings.failure_scenario: Reordering buttons would fail the test even when each action remains usable.
